steps.text: Bread (55/70 g) toasting — this is a thicker cut than usual, it is carrying the plate.
Spinach (60/80 g) into a dry pan on medium, 60 seconds to wilt. Out, squeezed, and seasoned.
Tomatoes (60/80 g) halved, cut side down into the same pan with the oil (3 g flat, rapeseed), high heat, 3 minutes until they blister and start to collapse. Salt.
Eggs (175/225 g — 3½ / 4½) beaten with salt. Heat right down, the rest of the oil in (2/3 g, rapeseed), and stirred slowly and constantly. Off the heat while still visibly loose.
Toast, spinach, egg heaped over, blistered tomatoes on top, spring onion (15/20 g), chilli flakes and lemon.

why: Low and slow, off early. This is a lot of egg — nearly four each on the larger cover — and the only thing standing between that and a plate of rubber is a gentle heat and the nerve to stop cooking while it still looks underdone.
notes: D0-003: both oil uses (blistering the tomatoes, then the eggs) are cooking uses — whole row renames olive_oil -> rapeseed_oil (5/6 g, unchanged grams), restated as 3 g flat at the tomato step plus 2/3 g remainder at the egg step (3+2=5 her, 3+3=6 him).
Two tracks: toast (toaster, done early) and pan (spinach -> tomato -> eggs, same pan sequential). Toast finishes well ahead and waits; total critical path ~7 min against the card's 9-minute chip.
